high_level_description: This image depicts an indoor museum setting with a modern and minimalist design. The space is well-lit with natural light streaming through large windows on the left side of the room. The ceiling features a grid of square lights, adding to the contemporary feel. In the foreground, there is a prominent display featuring a large, intricately carved stone sculpture of a mythical creature, possibly a dragon or a lion, perched on a pedestal. The base of the pedestal has a textured, wave-like pattern, enhancing the visual appeal of the exhibit.
